principles: Prefer local deterministic checks before AI review.
Keep trading gates authoritative and paper-only unless explicitly reviewed.
Adopt lightweight tools before heavy frameworks.
Sandbox trading engines and agent frameworks before production integration.

adopt_now.name: OpenGrep
adopt_now.local_role: Scan-only construction-time security and correctness findings.

adopt_now.name: pytest
adopt_now.local_role: Regression proof for queue, scoring, dashboard, pipeline, and validation behavior.

adopt_now.name: pytest-xdist
adopt_now.local_role: Parallel test execution for full-suite speedups.

adopt_now.name: Ruff
adopt_now.local_role: Narrow undefined-name construction check before tests.

adopt_now.name: compileall
adopt_now.local_role: Fast import/syntax construction check before slower tests.

candidate_next.name: Pandera
candidate_next.local_role: Schema checks for OHLCV, feature, metric, and walk-forward dataframes.
candidate_next.adoption_gate: Add to one data boundary first: raw/validated OHLCV.

sandbox_later.name: vectorbt
sandbox_later.local_role: Vectorized exploratory research comparator, not authoritative event engine.
sandbox_later.reason: Useful for speed sweeps, but needs parity checks against current backtest engine.

sandbox_later.name: NautilusTrader
sandbox_later.local_role: Reference architecture for event-driven execution, fills, clocks, and portfolio accounting.
sandbox_later.reason: Powerful but heavy. Sandbox as a comparator, not a replacement.

sandbox_later.name: Qlib
sandbox_later.local_role: Research reference for ML factor pipelines and point-in-time data handling.
sandbox_later.reason: Large platform; useful ideas may be imported without adopting the stack.

sandbox_later.name: MLflow
sandbox_later.local_role: Candidate for strategy experiment lineage if JSONL/reports become hard to query.
sandbox_later.reason: Adopt only if current review logs become insufficient.

sandbox_later.name: LangGraph
sandbox_later.local_role: Possible future explicit state graph for AI-assisted review workflows.
sandbox_later.reason: AI-dependent. Keep outside core deterministic checks.

sandbox_later.name: CrewAI
sandbox_later.reason: AI-dependent. Current local rule-based multi-agent scorer is safer for core gates.

avoid_for_now.name: AutoGen
avoid_for_now.reason: Maintenance mode; do not build new local infrastructure on it.

avoid_for_now.name: Great Expectations
avoid_for_now.reason: Strong but heavier than needed for dataframe-boundary checks; prefer Pandera first.

avoid_for_now.name: OpenHands/Aider as core automation
avoid_for_now.reason: Useful for human-driven coding, but not appropriate as automatic local healing in a trading safety path.
